description: This file defines a Tiptap extension for table cell nodes, including attributes and rendering logic, as part of the Notesnook project.

classes.name: TableCell
classes.description: A Tiptap Node extension for creating table cells with customizable attributes.

methods.name: addTableCellAttributes
methods.description: Defines and returns the attributes for table cells, including colwidth, colspan, rowspan, and style attributes.
